info.name: Frontend Insight
info.summary: Know what happens in your client's browser
info.description:
🔍 **Capture and analyze JavaScript errors from your users' browsers in real-time!**
FrontendInsight gives you **visibility into frontend issues that would otherwise go unnoticed**.
✨ **Key Features:** • 🐛 Automatic tracking of client-side errors and unhandled promise rejections • 📊 Browse events with advanced filtering and sorting • ⏰ Configurable data retention policies with automatic cleanup • 👥 Restrict reported events browsing to specific user groups • 🛡️ Built-in rate limiting to prevent abuse • 🚀 Modern UI built with Svelte 5
**Identify and fix frontend bugs before they impact your users' experience!**
info.author: Magnus Anderssen
